verdict.rationale: An API is a fair question for an online legal-services SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no public API, let alone one with UI parity. Every documented capability (filings, dashboard, document storage, notifications) is delivered through the web account or human services. The llms.txt probe only offers guidance for AI crawlers and is not a programmatic API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
